cards.text:
Five columns of premium summon-light descend into Niflheim’s lobby and
resolve into five newly summoned Heroes around the circle. [ 20-Gem pack
purchase accepted ] [ Premium Summons performed: 5 ]
Summon reveal — pull 1 of 5: the seal strains, recoils, and releases; a silver response signals a three- or four-star result. The Hero identity remains sealed until the next static card.
System panel — Hero acquired (pull 1 of 5): Odelia Marr — 3 stars (portrait unavailable)
Summon reveal — pull 2 of 5: the seal strains, recoils, and releases; an iron response signals a one- or two-star result. The Hero identity remains sealed until the next static card.
System panel — Hero acquired (pull 2 of 5): Perrin Vale — 2 stars (portrait unavailable)
Summon reveal — pull 3 of 5: the seal strains, recoils, and releases; a silver response signals a three- or four-star result. The Hero identity remains sealed until the next static card.
System panel — Hero acquired (pull 3 of 5): Wren — 3 stars
Summon reveal — pull 4 of 5: the seal strains, recoils, and releases; an iron response signals a one- or two-star result. The Hero identity remains sealed until the next static card.
System panel — Hero acquired (pull 4 of 5): Liora Fen — 2 stars
Summon reveal — pull 5 of 5: the seal strains, recoils, and releases; an iron response signals a one- or two-star result. The Hero identity remains sealed until the next static card.
System panel — Hero acquired (pull 5 of 5): Rowan Kest — 2 stars
System panel — Heroes acquired: Odelia Marr — 3 stars (portrait unavailable); Perrin Vale — 2 stars (portrait unavailable); Wren — 3 stars; Liora Fen — 2 stars; Rowan Kest — 2 stars

Iselle zips into the center of the fading summon-light, wings buzzing, her
smile bright and sharp.

cards.speaker: Iselle
cards.text:
Welcome to Niflheim, fresh arrivals—the lobby! That silent Master owns this
roster and decides who gets deployed. The gate leads to a separate, lethal
floor. Once deployed, you choose how you fight; clear the objective and
survivors return. The ordinary gate will not bring you back early.

cards.speaker: Iselle
cards.text: Death or synthesis is permanent. Cheerful, simple, and absolutely final!

Iselle: Death or synthesis is permanent. Cheerful, simple, and absolutely final!
